description: Yum! Brands, Inc., incorporated under the laws of the state of North Carolina in 1997 with principal executive offices at 1441 Gardiner Lane, Louisville, Kentucky, has over 63,000 restaurants in 155 countries and territories primarily operating under the four concepts of KFC, Taco Bell, Pizza Hut and Habit Burger & Grill, and it does not directly own or operate any restaurants, with restaurants owned or operated by its subsidiaries referred to as Company-owned.
